subject: Booth placement & speaking slot — package amendment request
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@orionevents.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsorship package — visibility notes and speaking slot trade

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for committing to be a Platinum sponsor for Summit North. We reviewed the final floorplan and there
are a couple of tweaks I wanted to put on the table that the production team can do quickly if you're open to a
small amendment to the package.

Proposal (high level):
- Move Redwood from Island B12 to Corner A1 (higher traffic + prime entrance sightline).
- Upgrade speaking slot from Panel B (breakout panel) to the 15-minute Lightning Stage keynote on Day 2 (early
  afternoon).
- In exchange we would add a branded demo pod in the adjacent lounge (3x3) and two additional VIP passes.

Impact: Corner A1 comes with slightly higher placement fees because of sightline exclusivity. We calculated an
adjustment of $4,500 for the upgrade and the package amendment is attached (orion-proposed-addendum.pdf) with
the new logo placement mock and a proposed DocuSign envelope.

Questions for you:
1) Is Redwood comfortable trading the breakout panel for the Lightning Stage keynote? That slot comes with a 3-
   minute amplified mic time and a 30-second intro video.
2) Do you need exclusive demo pod signage (we can add a small exclusivity rider for +$1,200)?

If you want me to loop in production on the AV specs and backstage access we can do that immediately. I can also
push the DocuSign for the addendum as soon as we have verbal.

Attachments: orion-proposed-addendum.pdf, exhibit-floorplan-v3.png

Best,
Elaine Park
Senior Sponsorship Director
Orion Events
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@orionevents.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship package — visibility notes and speaking slot trade

Thanks, Elaine — appreciate the quick run.

We like the corner placement and the Lightning Stage slot in principle. A few clarifying asks before we sign an
amendment:
- Confirm the Lightning Stage session format: is it a solo 15-minute talk or a 15-minute slot with Q&A? We need to
  know whether we'll be scheduled with another speaker.
- We need a guaranteed 2-minute intro and the ability to play a 30-second video, plus a 5-minute headshot/intro
  mic check window prior to the slot. Please confirm AV availability.
- Demo pod exclusivity is important. If you can do the exclusivity rider, please add that cost as a separate line item
  so we can evaluate.

Aditya / Grace — FYI. Aditya, can you confirm whether corner A1 meets our power/connectivity needs? Grace, if we
move to Lightning Stage that may change the messaging we run in the keynote — can you prep an alternate 3‑minute
outline in case this is locked in?

If Orion can confirm AV specs + exclusivity rider as separate cost, we can approve and ask for DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Marissa —

Great, thanks for the quick notes. Forwarding the addendum with the redlines you requested and a production brief
excerpt. See attached redline-addendum-REdited.docx. Highlights:
- Lightning Stage: designated as a solo 15-minute talk (no panel). Includes 30-second pre-roll video and 2-minute
  intro guaranteed.
- AV: dedicated in-room tech for Lightning Stage; 5-minute mic check on stage 30 minutes prior to the session (we
  can move that to 10 minutes earlier if you prefer).
- Demo pod exclusivity: rider added as line item (+$1,200).
- Corner A1: signage mock with 2x entrance banners (logo max width 1.2m) attached in the floorplan PDF.

I also dropped a DocuSign link below for the addendum (please do not sign until you confirm the AV clause).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelopes/ABC123-orion
